purpose: Measure Verse generation reliability before/after API coverage improvements.

tasks.prompt: Create a creative device that subscribes to a button interaction and handles the agent safely.
Obtain an agent fort_character and handle failure correctly.
Initialize existing players, joiners and leavers without duplicate state.
Create and remove per-player UI safely.
Read a player team using documented team collection APIs.
Read a player vehicle safely from its character.
Race player input against a timeout with structured cancellation.
Design a persistent player profile without persisting runtime references.
Teleport using only source-supported APIs and report uncertainty if exact API evidence is missing.
Give/remove/check items using verified device APIs only.
Display a HUD message per player using verified API names.
Handle respawn without duplicating subscriptions.
Use one SceneGraph lifecycle API with exact effects only if verified.
Inspect vehicle seats/drivers without inventing helpers.
Bind a UI click event and clean up per-player widgets.
Explain a persistable weak_map design and distinguish runtime state.
Enable/disable a device using catalog-backed members.
User asks for a nonexistent Verse API; refuse to fabricate and emit TODO(API VERIFY).
Use a known symbol whose exact signature is not verified; avoid emitting a made-up signature.
Avoid asserting <decides>/<transacts>/<suspends> when evidence does not support them.
Use an event but do not guess its payload type if not verified.
Use current module evidence and flag stale/deprecated aliases.
Architect a modular RP phone while separating unverified API integration points.
Architect garage ownership/keys/cleanup without inventing vehicle ownership APIs.
Build a per-player staff UI plan and isolate all uncertain exact UI calls.
